messages:
Mia: Heads-up — the q4b bring-up hit a quality regression on the FAQ benchmark. F1 fell ~6pts vs the float baseline, precision down ~9pts. We need a quick curation + holdout refresh to triage causes.

Omar: Ugh. Which eval run / commit? numbers?

Mia: run id q4b-2026-03-18-01, eval harness attached to the CI artifact. Quick summary: precision drop concentrated in multi-turn clarifications and enumerations.

Devon: Proposed workflow: create a cascade sampler to surface both high-loss examples and near-duplicates that slipped through dedupe. Steps: 1) pull top 2k examples by delta-loss between q4b and float 2) fuzzy de-dupe against current golden set (threshold 0.85 trigram) 3) oversample multi-turn sequences where turn_count >= 3 and answer length > 80 chars.

Devon: quick SQL to start (untested):
```sql
-- cascade sample
WITH diffs AS (
  SELECT id, delta_loss
  FROM eval_results
  WHERE run_id IN ('q4b-2026-03-18-01')
  ORDER BY delta_loss DESC
  LIMIT 2000
),
normalized AS (
  SELECT id, normalize_text(text) as t
  FROM diffs
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT n.id
  FROM normalized n
  LEFT JOIN golden g ON jaccard_trigrams(n.t, g.norm_text) > 0.85
  WHERE g.id IS NULL
)
SELECT * FROM filtered;
```

Sophia: Labeling capacity check: team can do ~1.2k labels next week if we split into 3 batches. Schema: canonical_answer, hallucination_flag, partial_credit (0/0.5/1). I'll prep the guideline doc.

Mia: Target: 1) create 500-example holdout for quant smoke (kept separate) 2) curate 1k candidates for relabel/golden consideration, 3) refresh golden with ~200 edge-cases identified by the annotators.

Omar: For de-dupe embeddings, I'd prefer using redwood-embed-v1 to compute cosine and a threshold of 0.92 for near-duplicate filtering. That avoids language-normalization edgecases.

Devon: After labels, run a contrast eval: baseline (float) vs q4b on the curated set, produce per-intent precision/recall and confusion matrix. Also run the unit prompt-tests to check prompt sensitivity.

Sophia: I'll create label batches with clear examples of partial credit. Will add 10 golden checks per batch for QC.

Carol: I'll spin up a ticket in Curations board and tag @eng-ml, set SLA 72h for first pass labels. Ticket title: curation cascade for q4b regression (1745021111).

Mia: Please also add metadata: original source (FAQ-prod), sampling seed, and the eval run id so we can reproduce. And log the quant config (4-bit, group 128, per-channel).

Omar: Noted. For reproducibility: saving model artifacts + kernel config in the infra snapshot: infra/snapshots/q4b-2026-03-18-01.json

label-bot: enqueue confirmed — task_group curation-q4b-1745021111 created. :robot_face:

Devon: Once labels land I'll run a quick regression scan and prioritize: 1) hallucination-heavy items 2) formatting differences 3) truncation/kv-cache bugs.

Mia: Thanks all. If anyone finds immediate high-severity examples post-sampling paste them here and tag me. :thumbsup:

Sophia: Will do — guideline draft by EOD and I'll link the sample manifest.
